removed.text: Gonza, this is urgent — please call emergency services right now, for example 911 in the US or 112, put them on speaker and follow exactly what the dispatcher tells you to do.
If someone else is with you, have them call while you stay with him.
If you can, also contact your pediatrician or go to the nearest emergency department right away after calling emergency services.
I am here with you — let me know as soon as you have help on the line.
